ValidationRule.description: Before a deal can move from Discovery to RFP or Scoping/Proposal, the following fields must be filled out: Goals & Priorities Pain Points Passport Value Risk & Red Flags Incumbent Next Step
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(Type, "New Business - New Customer"), ISPICKVAL(Type, "New Business - Cross-Sell") ), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Discovery"), OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "SE Technical Review"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Proposal") ), OR( LEN(Metrics__c) = 0, LEN(Identify_Pain__c) = 0, LEN(Decision_Criteria__c) = 0, LEN(Decision_Process__c) = 0 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Before a deal can move from Discovery to SE Technical Review or Proposal, the following fields must be filled out: Metrics, Identify Pain, Decision Criteria, and Decision Process.
